description:
FILED s512 (Fable, 2026-10-07) by the static-parsing review (docs/static-parse-limits-review-s512.md, family C).  Probe in ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s512/review/static: p05-bigint (perl 5.40.3 vs ./pcl on main 3ea47a41).

perl's mechanism: `overload::constant integer => sub {...}, float => ..., binary => ...` installs handlers in %^H that the TOKENIZER calls for every numeric literal in the lexical scope; bigint/bignum/bigrat use it to turn literals into Math::BigInt / Math::BigFloat / Math::BigRat objects, and also export `inf`/`NaN` and override `hex`/`oct`.  So it is a parse-time effect of a pragma (family C), lexically scoped, and the operators then run through Math::BigInt's overloads (which PCL has: the Math::BigInt shim, #1061 family).

What a fix needs: (1) `overload::constant` as a COMPILE-time fact the transpiler reads from the `use bigint` statement (a shim-declared fact, like a prototype: `lib/bigint.pm` says 'integer literals in my scope are Math::BigInt->new("...")'), scoped to the enclosing block/file at transpile time; (2) the literal emission wraps the literal's TEXT (not its float value -- 2**100 must not pass through a double); (3) `no bigint` ends the scope.  The general `overload::constant` (a user module's handler run at compile time) stays in the #2610 family: the handler is CODE that would have to run at transpile time.  Until built: an announcement at `use bigint` (rule 12 effect-only boundary) and a not-supported.md entry.  Low priority unless the everyday corpus or a target module uses it.

=== DONE (s513f) ===
A module whose import calls `overload::constant KIND => \&NAME` makes each numeric literal of KIND in the `use`'s lexical scope (to a `no MODULE`) the call NAME('TEXT') -- Parser2::_apply_constant_handlers, a token pass before every other pass. Shims lib/bigint.pm (Math::BigInt; floats truncated on the TEXT; hex/oct/inf/NaN), lib/bignum.pm (BigInt upgrading to BigFloat), lib/bigrat.pm (ANNOUNCED once on stderr: Math::BigRat broken under PCL, task 3000). Runtime: a range's endpoints numify from the BOX (an object's 0+ overload; Math::BigInt->new(1) .. 10 was an address). Guard Pl/t/bigint-01.t (10 rows, all fail on main). ir-spec Â§5 + not-supported.md.
subject: `use bigint` / `use bignum` / `use bigrat` are SILENT: `use bigint; print 2**100` prints 1267650600228229401496703205376 in perl, 1.26765060022823e+30 in PCL -- compile-time CONSTANT OVERLOADING (overload::constant: every numeric LITERAL becomes a Math::BigInt object as it is parsed) is not implemented, and nothing announces it
